description: A painted scene of a dim laboratory. A hand in a grey sleeve holds chalk at a large wooden-framed chalkboard covered in a grid of hand-drawn marks: dashes, dots, tally-like strokes and squiggles, with no legible letters. Strings of wooden and glass beads hang on the right edge. Glass flasks, tubing and stacked papers sit at the bottom. A single lamp lights the scene from above, in a dark, warm oil-painting style. The painting runs edge to edge with no visible frame.
